description: Capabilities for the main window: the app's own native commands (timelog.rs) work without any entry here — Tauri v2 only gates plugin-provided commands — so this file exists specifically for the two plugins added for reliable file downloads (see src/lib/r2.js's downloadProtectedFile), plus two explicit window permissions for the exit-confirmation dialog (see main.js's wireCloseConfirmation) added 2026-09-21. core:default already includes core:window:default, which should cover close/destroy for the app's own main window on its own - these are listed explicitly anyway so the exit flow can never end up unable to actually close the window over an ACL gap that couldn't be fully verified against live Tauri v2 docs from this sandbox.
